output.summary: Group ticket time of about 17.6 minutes outside Riverside is the documented, board-accepted result of the 2024 Made Here redesign. All nine sites rose in October 2024, and the board set a 19-minute ceiling. Satisfaction, same-store sales, check size and margin all improved afterward. The Pellston benchmark excludes scratch kitchens, so it is not comparable. Riverside's spike traces to the unfilled saute/pasta vacancy, which KDS timings, staffing records and the deferred transfer requests all point to. Why Delgado left is disputed and unresolved. Frozen components, a 12-minute bonus target and replacing the GM are harmful. Restoring Riverside staffing and resetting the baseline are preferred.
